Junho Kim



I'm a postdoc at Cornell Tech, working with Prof. Hadar Averbuch-Elor. I am interested in building machines that can understand the rich spatio-temporal contexts in our world, and ultimately contribute to advances in science and humanities.

Contact: junho.kim@cornell.edu
